openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The D-Link DIR-878 is a Wi-Fi 5 Wave 2 router based on MediaTek MT7621A with 16 MB flash and 128 MB RAM. It has 5 Gigabit Ethernet ports and dual MediaTek MT7615N radios, capable of up to 4x4 streams on each band.
openwrt_wiki.installation: OpenWrt main (formerly master) images can be installed via the stock firmware on this router using the factory image file. The unencrypted file for the recovery interface is now named recovery. OpenWrt 23.05 and older cannot be installed through the stock firmware on this router, as it only accepts properly signed and encrypted files in D-Link SHRS format. Use the D-Link Recovery GUI instead to upload the OpenWrt factory image for this router.
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: Remove the 4 rubber feets and the 4 screws underneath them, then carefully unclip the plastic tabs around the top cover. All of the tabs are on the top cover.
openwrt_wiki.fotos: Front media:dlink:dir-878-a1.png, Back media:dlink:dir-878-back.png; Typenschild- und Platinenfoto fehlen (FIXME)
notes: This router has nearly identical internals and the same specs as the D-Link DIR-867 A1, D-Link DIR-882 A1 and Motorola MR2600 v1 apart from the lack of USB ports.
Due to this similarity, most software/hardware mods and even firmwares for the DIR-867, DIR-882 and MR2600 can be applied to this router without issues.
D-Link DIR-1760 A1, D-Link DIR-1960 A1, D-Link DIR-2640 A1 and D-Link DIR-2660 A1 also are very similar to this router, but they have more RAM (256 MB) and flash (128 MB NAND).

openwrt_wiki_dir867.flash_warnung: Factory and Config2 partitions contains unique data, specific to each unit. If they get erased or corrupted, stock firmware will lose the ability to automatically apply firmware updates, will get stuck on a bootloop if a factory reset is performed and Wi-Fi won't work anymore. D-Link Recovery GUI cannot fix this.

tftp.hinweis: these flashing modes can only be selected by interacting with the U-Boot terminal at boot time, through the serial port

openwrt_wiki_dir867.debricking: In case of a brick, a new firmware can still be uploaded through D-Link Recovery GUI. Keep in mind the recovery GUI only accepts unencrypted firmware images. ... Since this router doesn't have a JTAG port, only reprogramming the flash chip through an external programmer can solve this kind of brick.
serial: Serial port is located on the J1 header, next to the Wi-Fi, Reset and WPS buttons.
It comes from factory without a pin header, you must solder one before you can use it.
The board uses 3V3 logic level, double check the specifications of the USB-TTL dongle you have before connecting.

deviwiki._text: Despite being labeled as an AC1900 router, this device appears to be identical to the AC2600 D-Link DIR-882 rev A1 aside from the USB ports. D-Link claims only 1300/600Mbps speeds but also claims that it supports four streams. The hardware is capable of four streams. FCC test reports show four-stream speeds so that's what we'll go with for specs.

werkstatt.zitat: Nicht jedes D-Link-Gerät hat diese Web-Recovery. Die DIR-Reihe wird über TFTP im U-Boot bespielt: beim DIR-878 A1 ist laut OpenWrt-ToH der Bootloader der TFTP-Server auf 192.168.0.1 und der Rechner der Client auf 192.168.0.101. Wer das mit einem HTTP-Upload versucht, sucht den Fehler an der falschen Stelle.
